text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday chaired a meeting of the Constitutional Democratic Rally (RCD, ruling party) politburo.
- Libyan army chief Abu Bakr Jaber Yunes on Monday held talks with Tunisian ministers of defence, interior and foreign affairs on bilateral coopertion.
- Consumers association to hold its congress on March 14 to 16.
- President Ben Ali calls for a RCD central committee meeting on March 14-15.
- Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) eighth anniversary was on Monday. AMU is not yet a reality for peoples in the region.
- French AIDS specialist Luc Montagnier says Tunisia was among the first countries to have taken preventive measures against the disease.
